singleSourced.value: Each platform has limitations when it comes to physical media capacity, but we believed that compromising the quality of the final chapter in order to achieve a fully on-disc release would ultimately not be in the best interest of many fans,
singleSourced.context: "Each platform has limitations when it comes to physical media capacity, but we believed that compromising the quality of the final chapter in order to achieve a fully on-disc release would ultimately not be in the best interest of many fans," said Remake trilogy director Naoki Hamaguchi in an online statement.
Final Fantasy VII Revelation will launch onto Xbox Series X|S on April 8, 2026.

singleSourced.context: Our own Ed Nightingale awarded the game four stars, calling it "an overstuffed but lovable re-imagining", a more generous take.
